source.title: Characterizing Desorbed Surface Contaminants Leading to Plasma Formation in Power Feeds of Pulsed Power Accelerators
source.page_text:
Figure 4.28: Allegra simulations at 40 ns into the current pulse of Mykonos shot 17133. The
images show the current, magnetic field across the gap, current density in the cathode, and
temperature in the cathode. The lineouts of each of the profiles shown are taken at either
the foil-edge location or the foil-middle location, as represented by Fig. 4.27, right panel.
[Simulation data courtesy of Alex Sarracino, Derek Lamppa, and Kyle Cochrane from Sandia
National Laboratories.]

source.hash_validation: PDF, page content and decoded RGB mandatory; lossless PNG encoding may vary

unit_interpretation.source_gap_axis_label: Distance from Middle of AK Gap [mm]
unit_interpretation.SI_columns_qualification: conditional literal printed-unit conversion only; not a validated dimensional benchmark

selection.mask_basis: conservative display interior with margins from visible corners/ramps; not material-boundary reconstruction
selection.run_rule: one contiguous exact RGB run of 2–8 pixels, separated from ROI boundaries

readout_bounds.current_recipe: entire matched run [first_x,last_x], extended by +/-2 pixels, mapped by fitted axis and expanded by max absolute current tick-fit residual
readout_bounds.gap_recipe: native row +/-2 pixels, mapped by fitted axis and expanded by max absolute gap tick-fit residual

nominal_initial_depth.basis: initial 5 mm symmetric gap and 200 µm foil in section 4.5/Figure 4.27

limits: Original simulation arrays, mesh, material fractions, component-frame mapping and normalization are unavailable.
The signed negative J_z values are preserved; no absolute-value replacement or sign rotation is applied.
Only a conservative smooth interior is retained. Legends, exterior/zero branches, corners, boundary ramps and every other unselected native row are catalogued and excluded.
Raster samples and their readout bounds are correlated, not independent experimental observations.
No moving-face coordinate, surface value, boundary peak, whole-depth integral or full cross-section is recovered.
No current-integral, Ampere-law, J-squared heating, conductivity, energy closure or drive-clock alignment is inferred.
The conditional SI columns do not verify the original printed normalization or authorize physical heating inputs.
Magnetic gap panels remain pending: their coarse foil support is not recovered here.
